predictionPoint: Start of the target semester T. Features use only semesters before T; labels come from semester T.

metaColumns.name: student_key
metaColumns.description: Pseudonymous, one-way hash of the student id. No names or roll numbers leave the app.

metaColumns.name: data_source
metaColumns.description: 'classvault' for real exports, 'synthetic' for generated test data.

features.name: n_prior_semesters
features.description: Semesters before T with a semester result.

features.name: sgpa_mean_prior
features.description: Mean SGPA over semesters before T.

features.name: sgpa_slope_prior
features.description: SGPA change per semester over the last 4 semesters before T (needs 2+).

features.name: sgpa_volatility_prior
features.description: SGPA spread around its trend before T (needs 3+).

features.name: cgpa_prior
features.description: CGPA reported for T-1, else mean SGPA before T.

features.name: attendance_slope_prior
features.description: Attendance change per semester before T (needs 2+).

features.name: backlogs_reported_prev
features.description: Backlog count reported with the T-1 semester result.

features.name: failed_first_attempts_prior
features.description: Subjects failed on first attempt in semesters before T. Later re-attempts are ignored because their timing is unknown.

features.name: failed_first_attempts_prev
features.description: Subjects failed on first attempt in semester T-1.

labels.name: label_risk
labels.description: 1 if semester T shows academic difficulty: any subject failed on first attempt in T, or SGPA(T) < 6.0, or SGPA(T) - SGPA(T-1) <= -1.0. Empty when semester T has neither SGPA nor subject pass/fail data.

labels.name: label_sgpa
labels.description: SGPA in semester T. Empty when not reported.
